description: This Java class 'OpenmrsCharacterEscapes' defines custom character escaping rules for JSON serialization, specifically to escape HTML tags such as '<' and '>'. It extends the Jackson library's CharacterEscapes class and is used within the OpenMRS project's codebase to sanitize JSON output.

classes.name: OpenmrsCharacterEscapes
classes.description: Custom character escape configuration for JSON serialization in OpenMRS, escaping HTML tags '<' and '>' to prevent HTML/script injection.

methods.name: OpenmrsCharacterEscapes
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the escape array, customizing ASCII escaping for '<' and '>' characters.

methods.name: getEscapeCodesForAscii
methods.description: Returns the array of ASCII escape codes, customized to escape '<' and '>' characters.

methods.name: getEscapeSequence
methods.description: Provides specific escape sequences for '<' and '>' characters during JSON serialization.
